Supreme Court: Homebuyers can seek compensation for delayed possession

The Supreme Court has ruled that homebuyers are eligible to claim compensation for delayed delivery of their properties, even after taking possession. This decision clarifies that the right to seek compensation is not extinguished by the act of taking possession of the flat. The ruling provides a significant recourse for buyers who have faced extended delays from developers.
